speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me evaluate your breast mass, can you describe when you first noticed it and if you have experienced any pain, nipple discharge, or skin changes in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the mass feel fixed to the surrounding tissue or the chest wall, and have you noticed any skin dimpling or nipple retraction? Also, do you have a family history of breast or ovarian cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will order an ultrasound to characterize the mass and request a biopsy to determine if it is benign or malignant. REQUEST TEST: Breast_Ultrasound REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the ultrasound showing a smooth polylobulated mass and the biopsy revealing leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth, the findings are classic for a Phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes tumor
